- Any teammates you want on the call (SRE, product)?

- Wed Dec 8 — 9:00–9:30am ET
- Thu Dec 9 — 11:30am–12:00pm ET

If none of those work, tell us a couple slots that do and we’ll shift. I attached the demo deck we intended to run. Marissa will include a 15-minute hands-on lab so you can see the runtime in your environment; if you prefer a longer walkthrough we can extend.

Thanks — we’ll keep it short and targeted.
